dataSource: City of Cincinnati Building Permits (Socrata open data portal), queried live
notes: Pulled live from the city's Socrata open data portal on every search, not a static extract — coverage reflects whatever the city has published as of your search, refreshed daily.
Matched by house number plus the first word of the street name; results may occasionally include unrelated records that happen to share both.
summary: Cincinnati is covered by a live query against the city's public building permits dataset, matched by address as you search.
